items.what: First dedicated custom-synthesis contract disclosed; operations targeted for Jan-2027 (as recalled by an analyst on the Q4FY26 call; CEO: 'hopeful by 2027 it will be commercialized or earlier or maybe later')

Long-term manufacturing and supply agreement for advanced intermediates with a 'major global pharmaceutical company'; capex Rs650-750 cr funded in phases by the customer's capacity-reservation advance

Three major dedicated projects, ~Rs2,000 cr together, ~70% capitalised; validations done and validation batches shipped; commercial supply after customers' filings and agency approvals; 'three different products completely'

capex.kakinada: Rs1,500 cr Phase 1 plan, Rs600 cr capitalised by Mar-26 (Q4FY26 call); six blocks operating, two under construction (AR FY26); Phase 2 with four production blocks under evaluation (Q3FY26 call)
capex.peptides: Peptide Centre of Excellence inaugurated (FY26); large pilot plant plus 'several 3,000-litre SPPS' reactors, more being added (Q4FY26, Q1FY27 calls)
capex.guidanceFY27: 'Constant capex' unless a new custom-synthesis project arrives (CFO, 23-May-2026)
capex.src: Screener cash flow; q4fy26; q3fy26; q1fy27; ar26 note on capital commitments

guidance.item: Revenue: 'we will show double-digit growth no matter what'
Margins: gross margin ~68% in Q1 'not consistent throughout the year'; FY27 EBITDA margin 'would be the similar as last year'
Dedicated projects: validations completed; commercial quantities only after customers' qualification and agency approvals; quantities and order book under confidentiality
Generics: four new DMFs filed (brivaracetam, ticagrelor among them); commercial volumes expected in 3-6 months; one customer negotiating long-term exclusivity
Iodine contrast media: long-term contracts with two customers being signed; one commercial, second in the next few months; gadolinium still in customers' Phase II/III
Inventory: rolling three-month raw-material stock since ~March-2026 at higher cost; no inventory gain booked
FY27: double-digit revenue growth; margins 'would remain stable'; capex 'constant' unless new custom-synthesis projects
Capex-to-revenue cycle: 6 months to 3 years depending on customers' approvals; 'to be optimistic... the 2-year range'
Gross asset turn back towards 1.5-1.8x over 4-5 years is 'what we are aiming at' (FY25: ~1.2x)

regulatory.item: USFDA import alert (99-32, 66-40) and warning letter on Unit 2 (Visakhapatnam); lifted in stages, removed 14-Nov-2017 and warning letter closed
Successfully concluded a USFDA general cGMP inspection at Unit 1 (Choutuppal)

US Section 232 proclamation: 100% tariff on patented pharmaceuticals and their APIs/key starting materials from 31-Jul-2026 (large companies in Annex III) or 29-Sep-2026 (others); 15% for EU/Japan/Switzerland, 0-20% for companies with onshoring/MFN deals; generics and their ingredients 0%

accounting.item: Revenue recognised over time Rs236 cr in FY26 (nil in FY25): custom-synthesis contracts where the product has no alternative use and Divi's has an enforceable right to payment; shown as unbilled contract assets (Rs125 cr net). Auditor's key audit matter.

Customer advances: Rs1,207 cr received in FY26 (Rs496 cr FY25); Rs456 cr interest-free refundable advance carried at amortised cost (the notional interest is most of the Rs23 cr finance cost); Rs402 cr deferred revenue from capacity-reservation contributions, released to revenue over the contract.
Labour Codes (effective 21-Nov-2025): Rs74 cr one-time past-service cost shown as an exceptional item in Q3FY26 (Rs55 cr after tax).
Forex: net gains on foreign-currency transactions sit in other income (Rs210 cr FY26, Rs48 cr FY25, -Rs7 cr Q1FY27).

Inventory: rose from Rs3,954 cr (Mar-26) to Rs4,413 cr (Jun-26) with a ~Rs500 cr inventory change in the Q1 P&L; analysts estimate the Q1 gross margin would have been 55-58% without it (IIFL on the call); management says no inventory gain was booked.
